meanings.meaning: To fan something is to stir the air so a fire burns stronger. It also names a tool used to toss grain into the wind so the chaff, the unwanted outer bits of the grain, blows away.
To fan a flame can also mean to make something stronger or more lively, the way stirring the air makes a fire burn higher. In 2 Timothy 1:6 it means to encourage and strengthen God's gift.
